Finally, the leader board page itself, Figure 23, clearly indicates the students 
current rank along the top, adhering to the hierarchical principles as described 
by (Gordon, 2020). The positioning of the student is determined by the quantity 
of gems they have accumulated. The top three students that are to be promoted 
are highlighted in a lighter blue, the bottom two students are highlighted in red, 
indicating that they are prone to demotion, while all other students that are 
highlighted in dark blue.  
 
 
Figure 24 Mock 
achievements activity 
 
The achievements page poses a significant challenge, since the quantity of 
information per card is high, the design needs to be dense and easily digestible. 
The badge, title and progress bar take up the majority of the view, allowing for 
an easily glanceable design. On the contrary, further explanations on how to 
earn the achievements is detailed in a smaller and less prominent description.
